independence_note: The Earthrise neighborhood was nominated after transcript review, but every scored state and timestamp comes from the fixed SAW Cam 3 image sequence and its PDS4 data label, not from transcript wording or OTR endpoints.

state_definitions.NOT_VISIBLE: No illuminated Earth pixels are visible in the fixed region of interest.
state_definitions.PARTIAL: Illuminated Earth is visible, but lunar occultation still removes part of the stable post-rise illuminated footprint.
state_definitions.FULL_CLEAR: The illuminated Earth footprint has reached the stable post-rise size and remains stable in the following frame. This describes clearance from lunar occultation, not Earth's illuminated phase.

measurement_note: The component measurements are a fixed corroborating diagnostic from an RGB-to-luminance threshold of 36 in full-image ROI (1800,700)-(3200,1900). Visual state remains the oracle because threshold area alone does not identify the occulting body.
